resources.string: Choose a preset for board colors and text.
Label and spoken text are required.
Phrase saved. Symbol could not be downloaded; a placeholder icon will be shown on the board.
This board can have at most 32 phrases. Remove a phrase or create a new board in the future.
Cannot add phrase. Board limit of 32 phrases reached.
Edits apply to the board last opened on the main screen. Open a topic board there first to edit its phrases. Folder cells are not listed here. There is no board picker in Settings in this version.
Drag the handle or use Move up / Move down to change board order. The board fills top to bottom, then left to right.
Replace every phrase on all seeded boards (Home and topic boards) with the app starter set, folder cells, and bundled icons. Custom icons and recorded audio for current phrases are deleted.
This deletes all current phrases and their custom icons or recorded audio on every board, then restores the starter Home + folder boards. This cannot be undone.
Boards restored to the starter Home + folder set.
Play a short test phrase using the device text-to-speech engine.
Speech test sent to the device TTS engine.
Speech output is unavailable. Check device TTS settings or audio output.
Organize related phrases with a subtle color on the board. Up to 8 groups. Colors are assigned automatically.
Group deleted. Its phrases are now ungrouped.
This board can have at most 8 groups. Delete a group before creating another.
Cannot add group. Limit of 8 groups reached.
Downloaded SymboTalk symbols are stored on this device for offline board use. Bundled starter icons do not count toward this limit.
Removes downloaded symbols that are not used by any phrase. Icons still on the board are kept.
Downloading a new symbol would exceed the cache size limit. Clean unused images or raise the limit in settings, then try again. Already-cached symbols can still be reused.

Board symbols may include artwork from SymboTalk and its symbol sets (including ARASAAC, Sclera, Mulberry, and Tawasol). Those symbols remain under their authors\' licenses (often Creative Commons). Vocal does not claim ownership of third-party symbol artwork.
